text:
Zoe (sales): Heads-up — HearthTech reported 500s from Dedicated yesterday after they started sending a custom X-Client-Token header. They called it P1 because their flow is customer-facing. Asking if we can get a patch in next-day.

Priya (support): Log snippets from their tenant attached. error shows `auth_middleware: unexpected token format` and then 502 -> 500 cascade. They repro on our dedicated test pool when we simulate their header.

Arjun (eng): Quick summary: bug introduced in 2026-02 runtime change that tightened token parsing for dedicated auth plugin. It fails on non-standard base64 variants we previously tolerated. Root is in shared auth helper used by dedicated variant.

Maya (product): Need decision: hotfix with point-release + canary for Dedicated, or schedule for next minor (2-week) release. Impact: customer SLA wants fix asap; hotfix increases operational churn. Thoughts? @Arjun @Emily

Arjun (eng): We can do a minimal patch that re-adds tolerant parsing. Low code churn (~6 files), unit tests trivial. Risk small but we need canary to watch for regressions. Estimated dev+test+deploy = 6-10 engineer-hours.

Emily (eng-ops): Canary plan proposal: 1) Build hotfix image tagged hearthtech-auth-fix. 2) Deploy to a 10% subset of dedicated pool (scale group dt-pt-canary). 3) Route only HearthTech tenant and a handful of synthetic requests. 4) 30m monitoring window: 5xx rate, tail latency, auth failure metric. 5) If green, ramp to 50% then 100% for that tenant. Rollback path same image previous tag. Can run deploy outside business hours if customer prefers.

Caroline (cust-success): HearthTech prefers early morning PST deploy (03:00 PST) but will accept sooner if we can promise short maintenance. They need a comms note and ETA.

Maya (product): Decision leaning: proceed with hotfix + canary targeted to their dedicated instance, then include fix in next minor to avoid divergence. We should also prepare comms, rollback plan, and a token of goodwill (1 week free Dedicated credits) per SLA. Approve?

Zoe (sales): Customer says credits are fine. Approve hotfix. Please confirm ETA and patch window for them.

Arjun (eng): I'll open PR now referencing this thread. Patch branch: fix/auth-tolerant-parse. Will add unit tests and a small integration job. Requesting review from @Emily for canary scripts. ETA: PR + CI by EOD, deploy tomorrow 03:00 PST if tests pass.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline started for branch fix/auth-tolerant-parse — build 4872 running.

Priya (support): I'll draft the comms for HearthTech: 1) short explanation of root cause; 2) schedule (tomorrow 03:00 PST); 3) expected user impact (none expected during canary), 4) rollback plan. Share for review when ready.

Emily (eng-ops): Once CI passes I'll prepare canary config and a rollout runbook. Will include exact grafana links and runbook checks. Also suggest we tag this hotfix in the release notes and link to the follow-up minor release where the change is merged.

Maya (product): OK — plan: hotfix -> targeted canary -> customer confirmation -> ramp -> include in next minor release. Comms + credit offer. I'll add this to the intake board and mark priority P1-customer.

Caroline (cust-success): I'll notify HearthTech of tentative window and credits. Will confirm once PR passes tests.

Zoe (sales): Thanks everyone. Please ping me in thread when deploy is scheduled so I can update the account team. :white_check_mark:

Arjun (eng): PR: https://git.redwood/inference/pull/6823 — ready for review. Tests green locally.

deploy-bot: CI build 4872 completed: success. Integration tests queued.

Emily (eng-ops): Integration tests passed. Scheduling canary deploy for 1729500000 -> 1729503600 UTC (maps to 03:00 PST tomorrow). Runbook link: https://go.redwood/runbooks/hearthtech-hotfix-canary

Maya (product): Thanks — going to update intake ticket and create publishable comms after Priya posts draft.

Priya (support): Draft comms posted: https://docs.redwood/comm-drafts/hearthtech-hotfix. Please review quick.

Zoe (sales): Reviewed. Good to send after final lines on the maintenance window.

Caroline (cust-success): HearthTech confirmed they'll accept 03:00 PST window. They asked for a short post-mortem once stable.

Maya (product): Great. Closing decision: hotfix approved and scheduled with canary. Follow-up: add regression test for token formats to CI and include fix in next minor release.

Arjun (eng): Merging PR now. Will keep watching post-deploy.

deploy-bot: Deploy started to canary group dt-pt-canary. Monitor dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/d/abcd/hearthtech-canary

Caroline (cust-success): Noted. I'll prepare post-deploy follow-up and PM update to HearthTech.

Zoe (sales): Keep me posted.

Emily (eng-ops): Canary looks stable after 45m. 5xx rate back to baseline. Proceeding to ramp to full for their tenant.

Arjun (eng): Confirmed stable. Closing thread after post-mortem draft is shared. :tada:
